summary: Injured female hiker on the Continental Divide Trail between Haystack Mountain and Troublesome Pass; fellow hikers gave first aid and called via satellite device; GCSAR ground teams carried her out and Grand County EMS transported her to Middle Park Medical Center.
location: Continental Divide Trail, between Haystack Mountain and Troublesome Pass
notes: Paged 5:30 pm Aug 31; teams on scene 9:50 pm; mission complete 12:30 am Sept 1. Near the Grand/Jackson county line; filed Grand. Distinct from id 1464 (Mount Toll stranded climber, same date).
